Question
========
How can some read after write dependencies be solved?


Answerlist
----------
* More ALUs
* Branch prediction
* Speculation
* Register renaming

Solution
========
When the dependency is only a reuse of the same architectural register name and not a real flow of data, giving the two instructions different physical registers removes the dependency entirely.

Answerlist
----------
* 0. More execution units do not help if the operand is not available yet.
* 0. Branch prediction addresses control hazards, not data hazards.
* 0. Speculation addresses control hazards, not register dependencies.
* 1. Mapping architectural registers onto a larger physical register file removes the false dependencies.
